description: Lossless editing JSON contract for kces.bytes.

abaVersion.description: The container format version recorded by the ABA extractor.
abaVersion.title: ABA/UnityFS version
abaVersion.x-meido-edit-guidance: Preserve it when round-tripping extracted data.
abaVersion.x-meido-game-usage: It identifies the source bundle context rather than changing the object payload itself.

x-meido-source-evidence.observation: The .bytes editing envelope preserves raw Unity serialized object bytes and sidecar metadata such as ClassID, PathID, load name, Unity versions, and optional TypeTree previews; the game-specific object schema is not inferred from arbitrary bytes.

classId.description: The signed Unity ClassID associated with the serialized object.
classId.title: Unity class ID
classId.x-meido-edit-guidance: Preserve the source value; changing it without rewriting dataBase64 makes the object undecodable.
classId.x-meido-game-usage: Unity uses ClassID to choose the object reader and TypeTree interpretation.
